Strike the beam once and let it ring. The decay contains every mode the
structure has, and reading them off a spectrum tests a piece of theory that
needs **no knowledge of the beam whatsoever**: the ratios of the natural
frequencies are pure numbers, fixed by the roots of
$\cos\lambda\cosh\lambda = -1$, and a measurement can falsify them without
anyone measuring a length, a thickness or a modulus.

That makes M3 the one mechanical experiment on this site whose central result
survives the beam's dimensions being undecided — and it is also where the
platform's timing quality finally becomes the measurand's own uncertainty,
because everything here is a frequency.

## What you measure {#sec-m3-index-measure}

| Quantity | How | Why it matters |
|---|---|---|
| $f_1, f_2, f_3$ | Peak picking on the free-decay spectrum | The structure's own dynamics |
| $f_2/f_1$, $f_3/f_1$ | Ratios of the above | Tests Euler–Bernoulli with no dimensions at all |
| Damping $\zeta$, two ways | Logarithmic decrement and half-power bandwidth | Two estimators with opposite biases |
| Mass-loading ratio | The strain channel, with and without the accelerometer | A systematic error the experimenter creates by measuring |

: What M3 produces {#tbl-m3-index-outputs}

## Bench {#sec-m3-index-bench}

**Tier 3.** The [beam rig](../../hardware/beam-rig.qmd) with strain gauges at
the root and an accelerometer that can be fitted and **removed** at the tip.

**Board.** Streaming is required and the rate must suit the *third* mode, not
the first — mbed boards only.

**Host.** Linux. A lost record puts a hole in a time axis whose whole purpose
is frequency.

::: {.callout-important}
## This experiment cashes in S1 and S2

Every result here is a frequency, so the sampling grid is not a detail.
[S1](../S1-daq-static/index.qmd) measured the grid's residuals and
[S2](../S2-daq-dynamic/index.qmd) measured the device clock's error in ppm —
which is a scale factor on every frequency reported here. Quote both.
:::

::: {.callout-warning}
## The reference data is synthetic

Produced by a seeded generator (`tools/synth/m3_vibration.py`) whose
parameters — including every beam-dependent quantity — are placeholders marked
`TODO (Paolo)` in `tools/synth/params/m3.yaml`. Only the frequency *ratios*
are tied to theory, which is exactly the quantity the experiment tests.
:::

::: {.content-visible when-profile="instructor"}
## Instructor summary {.instructor-note}

Four hours, tier 3, postgraduate. The two failures that waste a session are a
double strike and unplugging the accelerometer instead of removing it — the
second gives a null loading result that looks like a measurement. Full notes
in the [handbook](handbook.qmd#sec-m3-instructor).
:::
